title: Canada visitor visa
visa_description: Usually up to 6 months, for tourism, visiting family or friends, or business visits.
source: IMM 5257, Application for Visitor Visa (Temporary Resident Visa), Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada

questions.prompt: What's the main purpose of your visit to Canada?
Will you work or study for more than 6 months in Canada?

stop_if.message: Working, or studying for more than 6 months, needs a work or study permit, which Ta'asheera can't prepare yet.

questions.prompt: Let's add your passport. You can upload a photo of its details page and confirm what we read, or type the details yourself.
When was your passport issued?

rules.message: The issue date can't be in the future.

questions.prompt: Which country do you live in now?
Which city or town were you born in?
And which country is that in?
What's your marital status?
What's your home address?
What phone number can Immigration Canada reach you on?
questions.help: Include the country code, for example +961 71 123 456.

questions.prompt: What do you currently do?
What's your job title?
questions.help: As your employer would write it, for example Accountant or Software engineer.

questions.prompt: What's the name of your employer or business, and your job title?
What's the highest level of education you've completed?
When do you plan to arrive in Canada?

rules.message: Your arrival date needs to be in the future.

questions.prompt: And when will you leave?

rules.message: You can't leave before you arrive.
Visitors usually stay up to 6 months. A longer stay needs a different application.
Your passport must be valid for your whole stay: a visa can't outlast it.

questions.prompt: How much money will you have for the trip, and in which currency?
questions.help: For example 4,000 CAD. Include what a host or sponsor will cover.

questions.prompt: Where will you stay in Canada? Give the name and address.
Will you stay with family or friends in Canada?
Who are they, how are they related to you, and are they a Canadian citizen or permanent resident?
Have you ever been refused a visa or permit, or been refused entry to or ordered to leave any country?
questions.help: Answer honestly: misrepresentation can bar you from Canada for 5 years.

questions.prompt: Have you travelled outside your country of residence in the last 10 years?

documents.label: Digital photo
documents.help: A recent photo that meets Canada's visa photo specifications, plain light background.

documents.label: Proof of funds
documents.help: Your last 4 months of bank statements, or other proof you can pay for the trip.

documents.label: Invitation letter
documents.help: From your host: who they are, their status in Canada, and where you'll stay.

documents.label: Accommodation booking
documents.help: Hotel or rental bookings for your stay.

documents.label: Letter from your employer
documents.help: Your role, salary and approved leave.

documents.label: Business registration
documents.help: Your business registration and recent tax returns.

documents.label: Proof of enrolment
documents.help: A letter from your school or university confirming you're enrolled.

documents.label: Travel itinerary
documents.help: Flight reservations and your plans in Canada.

documents.label: Travel history
documents.help: Copies of earlier visas and passport stamps from the last 10 years.
